'''Lugus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as part of a popular [[Drogheda Revolutionaries|revolutionary movement]] that aimed at replacing [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda's]] [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] with a [[Democracy/Legends|democratic]] government after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Lugus was stationed at the [[Mount Meru Mine]], a major revolutionary stronghold, when it came under attack by regime forces who flooded the cavern. Lugus was nearly swept away by the rushing waters, and those that managed to escape the [[Mining/Legends|mine]] were summarily executed by soldiers waiting at the cave's entrance.<ref name="marvel83" />
